description: Outlines a report definition (RDL or RDLC) to plan a change: its page, datasets and fields, parameters, and every item top to bottom with its kind, place and size in cm, what it shows and does (hidden, toggled, page breaks), and its role (title, table, totals, declaration, signature...), which role:signature and the like name in edit_report and validate_report whatever the report calls the item. Returns version (edit_report's baseVersion) and outline; with item, that part's XML as written, with its lines (to copy an edit's find from).

detail.description: "full": every text whole and why each role was guessed.

item.description: One part in full: a name, a role (role:signature) or a path (WorkInstructions/TablixRow[3]): its outline and XML.

rdlc.description: The report definition's XML (RDL or RDLC).

name: describe_report
title: Outline a report
